note.item: Detailed plugin-specific release notes for version 4.0.17 are not available in the supplied package.
Bundled UIkit library: 3.25.26. The following notes describe the library release, not a separate plugin version.

Fixed
Fix handling of canceled Pointer Events while dragging Sortable items
Fixed
Fix preventing Slider autoplay from starting its next transition before the prior one is painted

Changelog metadata update (2026-11-06): Release notes are now maintained as XML and published centrally at https://github.com/joomlaplates-de/changelogs. This package includes its release snapshot as changelog.xml.

fix.item: **Assets not in page source:** UIkit CSS and JS were sometimes missing from the HTML source (e.g. with caching or certain plugin order). The plugin now registers assets in `onAfterDispatch` as well, so they are attached to the document earlier and reliably appear in the output.

change.item: **Descriptions:** All references to “UIkit 3” were updated to “UIkit 4”, and “Joomla 4, 5, and 6” to “Joomla 5 and Joomla 6” in:
**Manifest:** Removed incorrect “Uikit 3 Version: 3.25.07” line from the description; replaced with “UIkit 4 (Joomla 5 / 6 core compatible)”.

fix.item: **Media path mismatch:** Plugin was registering assets under `media/plg_system_uikit4/` while the manifest installs files to `media/uikit4/`. Asset paths in `src/Extension/Uikit4.php` were updated to `media/uikit4/` so CSS and JS load correctly.

**Provider robustness:** `services/provider.php` now handles a `null` return from `PluginHelper::getPlugin('system', 'uikit4')` (e.g. when the plugin is disabled or not found) and uses an empty config array instead of casting null.

note.item: **Added** `<targetplatform name="joomla" version="^(5|6)\."/>` in the manifest so the extension is explicitly compatible with Joomla 5.x and Joomla 6.x.
**Verified** plugin works on Joomla 5 and Joomla 6 with and without the compatibility (comp) plugin.
System plugin loading UIkit CSS/JS via Web Asset Manager.

UIkit Icons script loaded as dependency of main UIkit script.
